basis: Follow-up to preserved fixed-speed policy FAIL. Pixel quantization can move estimated TTC across the 500-ms gate after its initial crossing.
engineering_assumption: Once estimated TTC first enters the 500-ms cue window, keep sensory cue active until the rendered note disappears. Continue sending the current bounded TTC countdown when valid.
claim_boundary: Frozen-policy timing transfer over fixed pre-map speeds only; no claim for mid-map speed changes or complete charts.
pass: All learning-on traces emit exactly one lane-0 DOWN within +/-73.5ms of note contact, followed by UP exactly 10ms later; repeated traces match exactly; weights unchanged; untrained seed 907 is silent at 1x.
